newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bolsa ends mixed, seen regrouping.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bolsa ends mixed, seen regrouping.

text.p: Argentine blue chips staged a mild retreat Tuesday but the broad market remained in positive ground, with profit-taking curbed by the bull run on Wall Street, dealers said.

"Investors are starting to cash in on their profits, as everyone expected," said Andres McKiguan at Velox traders. "I'd say the correction could last until the end of the week, although selling is very selective and has been offset so far by the rally on Wall Street."
The blue-chip MerVal index shed 0.3 percent to 607.19, while the broad market edged up 0.1 percent.
"The MerVal is facing pretty stiff resistance between 610-620, and the consensus is that here we have to pause," said one technical analyst.

The index stands 6.4 percent higher so far in November but has been unable to reclaim the year's highest mark of 615 set in May. "If prices consolidate now at these levels we could set a new record (for 1996) early December," said the analyst.
Traders noted energy stocks were the best performers.
"There was a lot of movement in electricity stocks driven by the private pension funds, which went out searching for bargains," said McKiguan.
